main_measure.name: OLS slope of excess Sunday-to-Wednesday 3-bar return on forecast
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 with a positive supporting check confirms; t <= -2 rejects; otherwise inconclusive

supporting_check.name: forecast-weighted mean excess 3-bar return of Sunday bars with forecast > 0

decided_by: The slope's t is 2 or more and the forecast-weighted mean excess return of Sunday bars with forecast > 0 is positive.
reading: Sunday bars for the measure are the bars with regime 'trending' that have a full 3-bar return inside their window, the coin mean is over the non-overlapping 3-bar grid of all its windows, the regression includes zero-forecast Sunday bars, and the situation check takes Sunday as a bar starting on Sunday UTC with a negative raw wkd_fall value and a positive forecast.
